subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Which dotenv sources, if any, should expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references, and what should happen when a referenced variable is missing?
rationale: The code change is mechanically bounded, but the policy controls credential propagation and whether lower-trust workspace files can influence provider/auth/runtime environment values.

options.title: Expand trusted sources only
options.body: Expand references for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, keep workspace credential/control protections intact, and define missing refs as fail-closed skip or error before implementation.

options.title: Keep dotenv values literal
options.body: Document `.env` values as literal and direct users to config `${VAR}` substitution, SecretRefs, or shell import for aliasing.

options.title: Expand all dotenv sources
options.body: Allow project and global `.env` expansion with broad security tests, accepting a larger workspace-trust and upgrade review burden.

recommendation.title: Expand trusted sources only
recommendation.body: Expand references for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, keep workspace credential/control protections intact, and define missing refs as fail-closed skip or error before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest current routing signal from global dotenv history and the adjacent state-dir env review/merge path.
